Portfolio

Projects, missions and visual work

A fisheries scientist based in Dakar, I assess West African stocks and turn fisheries data into management advice. This page brings together the projects I have contributed to, the missions along my career and a selection of visuals I design to explain methods.

Research projects

From stock to ecosystem: the projects I have contributed to, my role and what I produced.

Ongoing

PAMBAS — West African deep-water shrimps

European Union (EMFAF) · Institut Agro, IEO-CSIC and partners · 4 EEZs, 7 institutions

Role: CRODT coordinator

What I did

  • Full R pipeline for CPUE standardisation of deep-water rose shrimp (Parapenaeus longirostris) and striped red shrimp (Aristeus varidens), from logbook cleaning to spatiotemporal models (sdmTMB)
  • Protocols and missions for at-sea observers on shrimp trawlers
  • Preparation of regional stock assessments
2021–2026

Sardinellas and small pelagics — FAO/CECAF

FAO/CECAF working groups on pelagic and demersal resources

Role: Assessor, co-author of working documents

What I did

  • Assessment of Sardinella aurita and S. maderensis with JABBA and Stock Synthesis
  • JABBA working documents on sardinellas (2026) and on P. longirostris and Penaeus notialis (2024)
  • Presentation of results to the working group (Agadir, 2026)

Outputs

  • Contributions to eight working-group reports
2019–2025

Tropical tunas — ICCAT

ICCAT programmes (AOTTP, JCAP-3) · IMR (Norway)

Role: Researcher, first author

What I did

  • Movements and sizes of little tunny (Euthynnus alletteratus) from tag-recapture data
  • Growth of yellowfin and bigeye tuna from otolith readings, in a Bayesian framework (Stan, brms)
  • Spatiotemporal abundance index for skipjack with sdmTMB (technical report delivered to ICCAT)

Outputs

  • Ba et al. 2023, Fisheries Research 266: 106761
2024

Canary Current food web — RCaN

CCLME project (FAO) · IMR (Norway)

Role: Modeller

What I did

  • Food-web model centred on round sardinella with RCaN
  • Training in Dakar, then in Tromsø (Norway)
2019–2021

DEMERSTEM — demersal resources

European Union (PESCAO) · coordinated by Agrocampus Ouest

Role: Postdoctoral researcher

What I did

  • First R scripts of the project and standardisation of abundance indices
  • Assessments of white grouper (Epinephelus aeneus) and southern pink shrimp (Penaeus notialis)

Outputs

  • Meissa et al. 2025, Fishes 10(3): 98 — four decades of white grouper status (co-author)
2014–2018

PhD — coastal demersal resources and the octopus fishery

Cheikh Anta Diop University, Dakar · ISRA fellowship

Role: PhD candidate

What I did

  • Assessment of ten coastal demersal stocks with production models
  • Octopus assessment (VPA, Thompson and Bell) and management options for the fishery

Outputs

  • Ba et al. 2018, Aquatic Living Resources 31: 8
  • Ba et al. 2016, PLoS ONE 11: e0156143
2012–2013

COMFISH — small-scale fisheries

USAID · University of Rhode Island

Role: Research assistant

What I did

  • Fieldwork on small-scale fisheries, the basis of my master's thesis

Visual work

Animations, video and figures I design for courses and talks. All are based on simulated data: they illustrate methods, not the status of any real stock.

Visuals: simulated data, for teaching. Projects: public information only.
